verdict.rationale: Lago's docs say it automatically generates invoices for each customer according to the plan model. Invoices can be downloaded, or the invoice object can be used to build a custom template. Beyond core invoice generation, the evidence says nothing about the other elements of the story. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential numbering, custom fields, memos, automatic delivery of documents to customers (e.g., email), tax/compliance assurances, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
